_why: Thresholds for scripts/desk_truth_monitor.py (operator 2026-10-22: "fix all of these n8n first for scheduling and monitoring"). Read-only monitors; each check writes its own LaneRunReceipt and queues at most one DIGEST host comms intent (P2) when its finding set GAINS a finding. Tuning a number here is a reviewed config change; nothing here can make a monitor write a store, a stop or a broker.

holdings_drift._note: accounts = the positions_current account keys compared (config/portfolio_positions.yaml required_accounts). Holdings freshness = the newest broker_position_as_of_at on those accounts' holdings.json rows (what schwab_position_sync stamps per row), falling back to the document's positions_built_at, which only moves when the position list changes.

options_desk_staleness._note: Desk freshness = the newer of options_proposals.json generated_at (full build, */10 12:00-15:59 ET) and quote_refresh.at (scripts/options_desk_quote_refresh.py, 09:35-11:50 ET). Until the quote-refresh lane runs, the 09:30-12:00 gap is a real finding every trading morning.

held_exit_coverage._note: Held = positions_current non-cash rows with qty > 0 (live accounts). A position is covered when stop_lifecycle (the stop_lifecycle_monitor snapshot) has a row for the same account and symbol whose lifecycle is in working_lifecycles. A position whose positions_current broker_market_value is below min_position_value_usd (fractional DRIP remainders, measured 2026-10-22: 14 of 27 held rows under $1,000) is counted as below_value_floor, not checked; a missing value is checked. Paper-account stop rows are counted and tagged PAPER; paper positions are not read (no broker read here). exempt: [{"account": "...", "symbol": "...", "reason": "..."}], each a reviewed operator decision.
